newsitem.title: USA: Dell Computer introduces two desktop PCs.
newsitem.headline: Dell Computer introduces two desktop PCs.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp on Monday said it introduced two desktop personal computers that incorporate Intel Corp's latest 233-MHz Pentium processor with MMX technology.
The Dell Dimension XPS M233s and OptiPlex GXi233 are available immediately, with prices starting at $2,399 and $2,423, respectively.
"These new PCs should provide faster performance for high-quality graphics, multimedia applications and Internet browsing," said Scott Mercer, senior vice president of Dell product group.
Dell's announcement followed the unveiling earlier Monday of Intel's latest Pentium chip with MMX multimedia technology. The 233-MHz processor is the fastest in its Pentium line, Intel said.
